console.lead: Agents do routine work (invoice matching, supplier follow-ups, cost checks, supplier watch) and only make proposals. Nothing is sent, recorded or approved until a person decides in the exception inbox.
console.disabled: Agents are switched off for this organisation. Turn them on under Settings below.
console.runsEmpty: Runs appear here once an agent has worked.

settings.title: Agent settings
settings.readOnly: Only the organisation administrator can change these settings.
settings.enabledHint: When on, agents check invoices, orders and suppliers on a schedule and raise proposals for people to decide.
settings.autoSend: Send supplier email from approved actions automatically
settings.autoSendWarning: Caution: when this is on and live email is configured on the server, an approved follow-up or document request is emailed to the supplier straight away. When off (recommended), it is kept as a test-mode record and nothing reaches the supplier.
settings.budgetHint: When the month's calls reach this number, agents that need AI pause until next month.

inbox.lead: Findings and proposals from the agents. Check each one and approve, edit or reject it; only then is anything carried out.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
inbox.viewOnly: You can view these findings; deciding needs the permission to decide agent exceptions.

detail.noAction: No action is proposed. Please check and handle this yourself.
detail.rejectHint: Rejecting closes the finding without doing anything. Please give the reason in the note.
detail.aiNote: Proposal generated by AI ({{model}}). It is not decided until a person approves it.

hint.creditNote: A request for a credit note (corrected invoice) is drafted to the supplier.
hint.mailTestMode: Supplier email is kept in test mode unless live email and automatic sending are both on.
hint.saveBrief: Saves a negotiation brief from the current facts for this quotation.
hint.negotiationTask: Opens a negotiation task for Chuo-Sogo staff.
hint.documentUpdate: Asks the supplier for an updated document.
hint.supplierReview: Asks Chuo-Sogo staff to review this supplier ({{month}}) for:
hint.applyImport: Imports the file's {{records}} records through the same steps as manual entry.

cost.lead: Should-cost models and negotiation briefs are reference material: they never change a price or an order by themselves.
cost.briefsEmpty: Briefs appear here when one is saved from a quotation or the exception inbox.
cost.modelsEmpty: No cost models yet. Use “New cost model” to add one.

extract.filled: The form below was filled from {{lines}} lines. Check every value before recording.

import.lead: Bring in purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoices from your own system as CSV, TSV or Excel files. Each file is checked first; it is imported only after a person approves it.
import.fileHint: CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx), UTF-8 or Shift_JIS, up to 10 MB.
import.waitingForAgent: The import check has not produced a proposal yet (agents may be off). Refresh in a moment.
import.profilesLead: Saved column settings map your system's column headings to our fields. Built-in presets cannot be changed.
import.defaultTax: Tax rate when the file has none (%)

supplier.title: Title
supplier.registrationHint: Enter the registration number as T followed by 13 digits; it is checked automatically.

staff.lead: Agent findings of every customer you are assigned to.
staff.decideInApp: To decide, open the desktop app, switch to this customer and use its exception inbox.
